adrs.title: Frozen Claude base model per agent
adrs.decision: Agents run as Claude Code subagents on a pinned full Claude model ID (frontmatter model:). SRS, Implementation and AI Review use claude-opus-5-5; DevOps uses claude-sonnet-5-5. Aliases (opus/sonnet) are not used because they move with new releases.
adrs.rationale: Agent = frozen base model + editable harness. The model never changes silently; behavior changes only through the harness (prompt, guardrails, memory, tools, skills, validation, plugins). Changing a model is a new ADR.
